trailhead.label: Grande Mouille car park on the road to Les Saisies, the board’s start

cautions: Working alpage: cows and goats graze beside the track in summer; keep your dog on a lead and give the herds room.
Farm vehicles use the track: lead on.
About 40 m along the Saisies road at the car park: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
